_note: Positions the game client does not give, and written routes, filled by hand. A dungeon (by id) or a zone (by French name) can have x, y (and world, 1 by default) and/or « route »: its steps in order, a step starting with « / » being a command the app copies (« /zaap x y », « /travel x y »), the others plain text (« Prendre le Transporteur frigostien vers Larmes d'Ouronigride »), where « [name](https://…) » links a quest to its page and « {skis} » shows the disposable skis' picture and « **name** » is bold (the zone to pick); a zaap and a /travel go in one step (« /zaap x y ; /travel x y »); « routeEn » for English (else route). A route replaces the nearest zaap the app computes. private/tools/client.py merges this file over the client's data; null = no « Aller en » button.
